DKU Registrar — Spring 2027 dates

All residence halls reopen Saturday, 9 January 2027 at 09:00. Undergraduate and graduate classes begin Monday, 11 January 2027.

Graduate and undergraduate commencement is Friday, 21 May 2027. All residence halls close Saturday, 22 May 2027 at 13:00.

Qing Ming (Tomb Sweeping Day): no classes Monday 5 April 2027.

chunks.title: Academic Building Dining
chunks.text:
Campus dining — Academic Building

Three dining halls on campus serve Chinese, Western, and Halal dishes. This note covers only the two Academic Building venues.

University Dining @ Academic Building:
Breakfast 07:00-09:30
Lunch 11:00-13:30
Dinner 17:00-19:30

Executive Dining @ Academic Building:
Lunch 11:00-13:30
No breakfast hours and no dinner hours are listed for Executive Dining.

This note does not list menu prices, meal-plan costs, or dish names.
